_note: Seed passages paraphrased from the project's own research documents. They are NOT official circular text. Each carries verification_status; no passage here states a subsidy rate, ceiling, margin or eligibility rule, so questions on those must abstain until a dated operative circular is curated into this corpus.

documents.title: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres: programme description
documents.passage: ACABC is a Government of India programme that uses the expertise of qualified agricultural professionals to set up agri-clinics and agri-business centres and to extend professional services to farmers. MANAGE publishes the programme guidance.

documents.title: Programme description: loan caution
documents.passage: The scheme makes training and access to credit possible but does not guarantee a bank loan. Sanction depends on project viability and the financing institution.

documents.title: Revised ACABC implementation compendium 2025 (listing)
documents.passage: The MANAGE site lists a revised ACABC implementation compendium for 2025 among the scheme orders and circulars. Its effective date and operative provisions have not been confirmed in this corpus.

documents.title: JanSamarth national portal release, 30 March 2026
documents.passage: The Ministry of Finance reported on 30 March 2026 that ACABC is among the credit-linked schemes available through the JanSamarth portal.

documents.title: ACABC progress and subsidy distribution, Annexure XII-F, status 30 September 2026
documents.passage: NABARD publishes a state-wise annexure of ACABC subsidy schemes and subsidy released, with a financial-year-to-date table and a cumulative table. These are subsidy-reporting aggregates, not counts of every graduate or every venture.
